PhD in Artificial Intelligence

MIT CSAIL

Cambridge, MA, USA

About the Position

We are seeking a motivated PhD student to work on natural language processing, with a focus on large language model alignment and reasoning.

Requirements

  • MSc in Computer Science or related field
  • Strong programming skills in Python
  • Prior research experience in NLP or ML

What We Offer

Three years of full funding, including tuition and a competitive stipend. Access to compute resources and a vibrant research community.

How to Apply

Submit CV, transcripts, statement of purpose, and two references via the online portal.
